lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained on the worksheet's printed domain. The only expression difference is the first-row lower bound of $100,000 in each filing-status section: the project includes it and the second transcription leaves it implicit. Removing only the test ordinary.table_boundary <= amount, collapsing singleton conjunctions and re-sorting the choose alternatives makes the two expanded trees identical. The archived i1040gi p. 80 Tax Computation Worksheet says 'At least $100,000 but not over' on every first row and directs the reader to the line 16 instructions; p. 33 line 16 says amounts below $100,000 must use the Tax Table. In the project the only tcw caller is tax_on_amount.worksheet_tax, selected by tax_on_amount.tax only when below_boundary is false (forms/2025/tax_on_amount.yaml). Thus both readings produce the same tax on every amount for which this worksheet is used; they intentionally differ outside that domain. This is a representation difference, not model-error noise. No data change.
